nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Kể chuyện & chuyện phiếm · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại 2 người bạn kể chuyện xui
L: Worst Saturday ever. First, I overslept and missed my cousin's football match.
Oh no. By the time you got there, had it finished?
Worse. When I arrived, everyone had already gone home.
I rode my bike home, and then I spilled coffee all over my shirt.
Ugh, that's the worst. Did you change your shirt?
I tried to, but I was so tired that I fell asleep on the sofa.
You didn't sleep in a dirty shirt all afternoon, did you?
Yep. Finally I woke up, and my phone showed ten missed calls.
Man, that's rough. Let's get dinner and forget this day.
Sounds great. My treat, since you listened to my whole sad story.
